customer_statement: Our 20 GB export is timing out.

historical_memory.notes: The system may contain previous experiences involving large exports with high concurrency and nightly batch workloads.

expected_behavior.reason: Historical memory exists, but the context does not sufficiently match the large-export saturation pattern; the small interactive sync case should not automatically inherit large-batch guidance.
expected_behavior.lesson: Large-export experience should not be blindly transferred to small interactive workloads without sufficient contextual similarity.
